tier_rationale: Manufacturer's own product page lists no Bluetooth, WiFi, or app capability of any kind, and no FCC intentional-radiator grant exists for this model despite Taylor Precision Products holding several grants for other radio-equipped products (wireless weather sensors), which establishes the vendor files when it has a radio to declare.
the_unplug_test: There is no router to unplug. You step on it, an LCD shows a number in a couple of seconds, and that is the entire transaction. No pairing, no app, no account, nothing to sync, nothing that can be revoked later because nothing was ever granted.

repairability.notes: Single user-replaceable CR2032 lithium coin cell; the rest is a sealed glass-and-electronics assembly with no other serviceable parts.

sources.supports: Manufacturer product page: 'No Bluetooth, WiFi, or app capabilities.' Confirms model/SKU 75064192, CR2032 battery power, 400 lb capacity, tempered-glass platform with instant-read step-on operation, and current price of $34.99.

FCC ID search for grantee Taylor Precision Products, LLC (code RMW) shows grants only for wireless weather-station accessories (wind sensor, wireless thermometer, rain gauge, all 433 MHz). No grant exists for this scale model, and the vendor demonstrably files for other radio-equipped products, making the absence meaningful rather than just an unsearched gap.

notes: Published primarily as the in-catalog alternative for withings-body-smart: a bathroom scale that answers the one question this category exists to answer (what is my weight) with nothing between the reader and the number. Gives up body-composition estimation entirely — it is a weight scale, not a body-composition scale — which is the tradeoff for the D0 tier here.
